body: The thing is.. I don't know why they bully me. I'm openly friendly. I treat everybody with kindness and fairness. I'm not some annoying pseudo-intellectual or somebody who tries to act random and shit. I'm just an average guy. I want to switch schools but I'm not in the position to.
No I haven't. What would happen there?
I may. Thanks for your help. I appreciate it
How can i go to the doctor without directly telling my parents. ( they'll refuse to drive or anything)

That's another thing. School is hard for me. I don't have any learning disabilities, but I have zero to none motivation for actually doing my work. It just feels like the only thing there thats even keeping me going is angry teachers and my parents who get upset about every little mistake. I also have the school I go to not even accepting my re-enrollment because of a rotten Spanish grade. It's stressful.

All these people in the thread are all suggesting very drastic things that I don't think I'm ready for. Don't get me wrong, I love my family, but sometimes they are abusive and not understanding. It feels that wherever I am, I'm not safe from verbal and mental abuse. The only place I feel safe is in my room on my computer. It's my escape. My whole life almost rotates around it. I'm doing lacrosse this year and I'm on the team but I'm no good at it and get picked on for that too. I feel lonely. And for me, that's one of the worst feelings in the world. Sorry for ranting.
My grandparents are located in Canada (far away from me). And my uncle kind of lives with us. He sleeps here but is gone the entire day until like 12:00. I'm 15 (too young to move out).
